name: koko VR Theater
summary:
**Your library. Your cinema. Your headset.**

koko VR Theater turns your Quest into a private cinema for video you already own. Sign in to any Plex or Jellyfin server — yours, a friend's, or family's — or browse your NAS and local files. No accounts, ads, or subscriptions.

**Play almost anything**
- 2D, 3D (SBS / Top-Bottom / Frame-Sequential), VR180 / VR360
- Apple spatial video (MV-HEVC), 3D Blu-ray (MVC), fisheye
- HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision; auto format detection
